rows.details: National Productivity Council (NPC), under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India
Training Officer (Senior Professional) – Training Business Development & Programme Management (Post code HRM-01)
Consolidated remuneration up to ₹50,000 per month
MBA in any discipline from a recognized institution, with minimum two years of relevant professional experience
HRM Group, NPC Headquarters, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About NPC
content_sections.text: The National Productivity Council is an autonomous body under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, with its headquarters at 5-6, Institutional Area, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003. As its notice describes, NPC promotes productivity consciousness in the country for sustainable socio-economic development through consultancy, research and training activities. This engagement is being made by the HRM Group at NPC Headquarters, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be sent by email; the notice gives no postal route. Fill in the application in the prescribed format at Annex-AF ("Application for engagement as contractual person in NPC"), printed in the notice. Give the details of experience in the proforma "APPENDIX" (Details of Experience), starting from the latest position, with the name of the office or organisation, post, remuneration or pay band with grade pay (if applicable) and a description of duties performed. Attach self-attested copies of all requisite documents and a recent photograph. Write the post code HRM-01 in the subject line of the email. Send the email to [email protected] on or before 16 November 2026 at 3:00 PM. Incomplete applications and applications without self-attested copies of supporting documents may be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Training Officer (Senior Professional) – Training Business Development & Programme Management, post code HRM-01, number of persons required 1. MBA in any discipline from a recognized institution. Specialization in Marketing or Human Resource Management is preferred. Minimum two years of relevant professional experience in marketing, business development, client relationship management, training coordination, event management or a related field. Experience in marketing training programmes, corporate learning and development, private-sector client acquisition or hospitality coordination is desirable. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Strong interpersonal, networking and follow-up skills. Proficiency in MS Office, social media and digital communication tools. Ability to independently coordinate training programmes and willingness to travel as required. The age limit is not specified in the notice. The application form asks for the date of birth with a self-attested proof. Remuneration: consolidated remuneration up to ₹50,000 per month, in accordance with the applicable Administrative Instructions of NPC and the marks/recommendations given by the selection committee. Annual increments and other entitlements: as per the applicable Administrative Instructions of NPC. Type of engagement: full-time contractual. Contract period: one year, extendable on a need basis up to a maximum total period of three years, subject to satisfactory performance and approval of the competent authority. Travel: official travel and admissible expenses shall be governed by applicable NPC rules and instructions. Place of deployment: HRM Group, NPC Headquarters, New Delhi. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: NPC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the work responsibilities of the Training Officer (Senior Professional) under six heads. Publicize HRM training programmes through email campaigns, follow-ups and participant mobilisation. Identify Government, PSU and private-sector clients; maintain a database of prospective participants and organisations. Generate leads, prepare/follow up proposals, and develop customized residential, in-company and online programmes, including webinars. Identify opportunities for pre-promotion and other specialized/customised training programmes. Identify potential consultancy requirements related to HRM while performing the above activities. Coordinate residential, in-company and online programmes, including participant communication, faculty and client liaison, venue/hotel arrangements and on-site management; travel as required. Welcome and assist participants, represent NPC in routine programme coordination, and coordinate conduct of training, participant departure and programme closure. Coordinate attendance, feedback, bills, supporting documents, participants' fee and internal invoicing follow-up, and programme completion reports. Maintain records and periodically report on nominations, occupancy, proposals, new client leads, consultancy leads and hotel empanelment to the Group Head (HRM). Coordinate the annual preparation of NPC's Training Calendar by collecting programme details from all Groups and Regional Directorates (RDs). Compile and standardise the information, and follow up with the concerned units for timely submission and revisions. Coordinate its publication on the NPC website after obtaining the approval of the competent authority. Coordinate hotel empanelment across India for NPC Groups and RDs. Maintain an updated location-wise database of hotels, facilities, tariffs, validity and service quality. Follow up renewals, address non-availability or withdrawal issues related to hotels, and identify suitable alternatives at key locations. Undertake any other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by the Group Head (HRM) from time to time, based on the functional requirements and needs of the office.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The Annex-AF form and the notice name these items to attach: Self-attested copy of proof of date of birth. Self-attested copy of Aadhaar. Educational/technical qualification documents, self-attested as true copy. Duly filled experience proforma "APPENDIX". A recent photograph. Copy of PPO, with the date of retirement and the name of the office where last working (in case of a retired person only). Any other relevant information on a separate sheet, if necessary.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy: Training Officer (Senior Professional) – Training Business Development & Programme Management, post code HRM-01.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NPC Training Officer post?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed on or before 16 November 2026 at 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NPC Training Officer (Senior Professional) post?
faq.answer: An MBA in any discipline from a recognized institution is required, and specialization in Marketing or Human Resource Management is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: A minimum of two years of relevant professional experience in marketing, business development, client relationship management, training coordination, event management or a related field is needed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NPC Training Officer (Senior Professional)?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated remuneration of up to ₹50,000 per month, in accordance with NPC's Administrative Instructions and the marks/recommendations of the selection committee, with annual increments as per those instructions.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annex-AF form with the experience APPENDIX, attach self-attested copies of documents and a recent photograph, and email it to [email protected] by 16 November 2026, 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written in the email subject line?
faq.answer: The post code "HRM-01" must be mentioned in the subject line of the email.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NPC Training Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a full-time contractual engagement for one year, extendable on a need basis up to a maximum total of three years, with no right to regular appointment or absorption in NPC.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidate be posted?
faq.answer: The place of deployment is the HRM Group, NPC Headquarters, New Delhi, and the work involves travel as required.

faq.question: Q10. Will NPC provide a laptop to the selected candidate?
faq.answer: No. The selected candidate should carry their own laptop for official work if required, as no laptop or desktop will be provided by the organisation.
